name: Prize: Twilight Forest
description: Fiery Blood or Fiery Tears plus an iron ingot.

pages.title: Fiery Ingot
pages.text: Fiery Blood or Fiery Tears plus an iron ingot. Only fiery metal survives the heat of a launch.

pages.title: Where
pages.text:
**Fiery Blood**: the **Hydra** in the Fire Swamp drops 7 to 10. You reach it after the Labyrinth.\
\
**Fiery Tears**: the **Ur-Ghast** atop the Dark Tower drops 1 to 5.\
\
One Hydra covers the core.

pages.title: How
pages.text: Twilight bosses drop into a chest where they started. Each lair holds one boss, but every new Fire Swamp or Dark Tower has another. [#](2E5AAC)[Cannons](entry://industry/cannons)[#]() and autocannons work well on the Hydra's heads. A Hydra Compass finds the lair: see [#](2E5AAC)[Boss Compasses](entry://stars/boss_compasses)[#]().
